luci-app-rollcall.description: Read rollcall status: members, roles, sender, recent reports, sandbox and storage state

luci-app-rollcall-admin.description: Change the rollcall group: invite, remove, roles, rotate, Telegram token and chat, admin takeover

read.comment: the admin page also reads the status, so the admin group carries the same read entry

write.comment: each entry is one exact command form. Options come before --, and a router name or, for invite, an address, the only glob, comes last after --; the CLI accepts exactly one word there and checks it (the roster name rule, or one IP address another router can reach). Recovery is not here: it is CLI-only, as root on the router.
